cache.key_contract: revision + feature version/code + source hashes + split hash/assignment + prepared input hash + token IDs hash

gate.interpretation: Development validation only; examined test split is not a fresh assessment.
gate.uncertainty: Paired independent-task confusion counts retained for all policies. Confidence intervals and statistical significance are unassessed; validation selection remains development-only.

quality_claim: Development validation only; TEST is spent and excluded.

evidence_archive.text_safety_check: Every positional record has text_redacted=true and only numeric audits or allowed structural strings. No source content, names, arguments, answers or call IDs.

invocation.observer_reads: Only numeric staged coverage/report and process accounting. No input records or model artifacts.

convergence.note: Completed status from the frozen driver implies no ConvergenceWarning and n_iter_ below 500. The reviewed driver did not serialize n_iter_; no claim of an exact iteration count is made.

result_validation.exact_result_commit_ci: Pending remote check at commit time; inspect PR head checks.
